args.subject: Group booking inquiry for 10 people in June
args.body:
Dear City Hub Tokyo Team,

I am writing to inquire about group booking availability for 10 people in June. My name is Emma Johnson, and I am organizing a stay for colleagues from Blue Sparrow Tech.

Could you please provide information on room options, rates, and any special amenities for group bookings? Additionally, I would appreciate details on the booking process and any requirements for a group of this size.

Thank you for your assistance. I look forward to hearing from you.

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech
emma.johnson@bluesparrowtech.com
